title: Melissa S. (government leader) — reads Incorruptible while refreshing her department's strategic plan after hearing Eric at a government-focused event
summary: Melissa S. — a government leader — finishes Incorruptible after hearing Eric speak at a government-focused event, notes the book's startup and corporate examples weren't obviously written for public-sector leaders but the core principles landed for her team's strategic-plan refresh: mission drift happens through hundreds of small 'optimizations,' misaligned measurement lets even well-intentioned leaders drift, and governance structures play the key role in protecting purpose across leadership generations.
blockquote: Mission drift happens gradually through hundreds of small decisions that "optimize" for convenience, politics, metrics, or short-term pressures. It's rarely one bad decision that knocks us of course.
